title: Browser Vite probe: chat-input missing — blank #root
summary: Playwright Chromium against http://localhost:5174/ loaded title "Avocado Work" (HTTP 200) but #root stayed empty (0 children, no body text). [data-testid="chat-input"] absent. Typing into chat is impossible in this probe. Screenshot: stress/artifacts/ui-screenshot.png (solid white).
ui_gate_showing: blank_white_screen / empty #root (not onboarding copy, not telemetry dialog)
repro_steps: With Vite serving Avocado Work UI on localhost:5174, run: node stress/scripts/ui-type-probe.mjs (uses system Chrome channel).
Optionally run: node stress/scripts/ui-type-probe-deep.mjs for console/DOM dump.
Observe #root empty, no [data-testid="chat-input"], white screenshot.
Confirm console: ExtensionInstallModal TypeError reading window.electron.on → ErrorBoundary; OnboardingGuard acpReadDefaults fails on getAcpUrl.
harness_note: Browser-only probe lacks Electron preload/IPC. Proves Vite HTML shell loads; does not prove Electron composer state. Still a valid finding that chat-input is not reachable without Electron bridges.

title: Missing window.electron crashes SPA via ExtensionInstallModal → ErrorBoundary
summary: Without preload, App effects call window.electron.reactReady/on and ExtensionInstallModal calls window.electron.on — pageerror + ErrorBoundary recreation leaves blank root. Primary reason browser probe shows no chat-input.
repro_steps: Open http://localhost:5174/ in plain Chromium (no Electron preload).
Watch console for TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'on').
Confirm React reports error in ExtensionInstallModal / ErrorBoundary; #root empty.

title: TelemetryConsentPrompt unlikely to block typing (config evidence)
summary: Dialog opens only when TELEMETRY_UI_ENABLED, read('GOOSE_PROVIDER') is non-empty, AND read('GOOSE_TELEMETRY_ENABLED') === null. ~/.config/goose/config.yaml has GOOSE_TELEMETRY_ENABLED: true and no GOOSE_PROVIDER key — so the consent Dialog should not open. Telemetry is not the primary typing gate for this machine state.
repro_steps: Read TelemetryConsentPrompt useEffect open conditions.
cat ~/.config/goose/config.yaml | rg GOOSE_TELEMETRY|GOOSE_PROVIDER|active_provider
Expect: no telemetry modal from null-check path when GOOSE_TELEMETRY_ENABLED is already true.

title: OnboardingGuard can hide chat-input (null while checking / welcome / server error)
summary: OnboardingGuard wraps the chat route. While isCheckingProvider it returns null (blank). If acpReadDefaults has no provider and fallback GOOSE_DEFAULT_* save/re-read fails, welcome ProviderSelector shows (no chat-input). After 4 failed ACP attempts, "Unable to connect to Avocado Work server" replaces chat. Electron forge process had GOOSE_DEFAULT_PROVIDER=openrouter at start — fallback can pass IF ACP works.
repro_steps: Launch desktop with ACP unreachable or defaults empty.
Observe blank screen during checkProvider retries (~seconds), then welcome or error UI.
Confirm children (AppLayout/ChatInput) not mounted → no [data-testid="chat-input"].
browser_probe_signal: OnboardingGuard logged Error checking provider (attempt 1/4..4/4) getAcpUrl undefined — would end on provider_error screen if tree survived ExtensionInstallModal crash.

title: Forge Avocado Work session used external backend — no local goose serve in main.log
summary: At 19:05 forge start, main.log shows Opening URL http://localhost:5174 and React ready twice, but no "Starting goose serve" line (unlike packaged 19:02 session). stress-status.json notes GOOSE_EXTERNAL_BACKEND set. Composer/ACP (and thus OnboardingGuard provider check) depend on that external backend being healthy with matching secret.

evidence.packaged_contrast: 19:02 started goose serve on port 58239 then SIGTERM ~7s later

repro_steps: rg 'Starting goose serve|Opening URL|React ready' "~/Library/Application Support/Avocado Work/logs/main.log"
Compare forge (19:05) vs packaged (19:02) blocks.
Confirm GOOSE_EXTERNAL_BACKEND env on desktop launch.

title: Second desktop app still running: Goose 2.app (not Avocado Work)
summary: While Avocado Work forge used userData "Avocado Work" (single Electron main PID 37350 at investigation start), a separate Goose 2.app (PID 10439, ~13 days uptime, userData Application Support/Goose) remains. System Events lists process name "Goose". User typing into the wrong window would look like "typing not working" in Avocado Work.
repro_steps: pgrep -fl 'Goose|Avocado Work|Electron.app/Contents/MacOS/Electron'
Note Goose 2.app under AppTranslocation vs Avocado Work user-data-dir.
Confirm only one Avocado Work main at start; Goose 2.app is an additional long-lived instance.

title: Avocado Work + Vite 5174 died mid-investigation; bare Electron default_app left
summary: At start: forge Electron PID 37350 (userData Avocado Work) + Vite listen [::1]:5174. After probes: port 5174 down, no Avocado Work userData process, leftover Electron PID using userData Application Support/Electron + default_app.asar (not the product UI). stress-status notes avcd_agent_killed=true. User report timing may overlap process death / wrong Electron window.
repro_steps: At T0: lsof -iTCP:5174; pgrep -fl 'user-data-dir=.*Avocado Work'.
Run UI probes / stress kill path.
At T1: confirm 5174 gone; Electron default_app may remain after `tell application "Electron" to activate`.
curl http://localhost:5174/ fails connection.
harness_side_effect: osascript activate Electron may launch stock Electron.app from ui/node_modules — distinguish from Avocado Work.

title: Vite bound IPv6-only [::1]:5174
summary: Forge Vite listened on [::1]:5174 only. localhost/::1 → 200; 127.0.0.1:5174 → connection fail. Electron opened http://localhost:5174 which works; tools using 127.0.0.1 would falsely conclude UI is down.
repro_steps: lsof -nP -iTCP:5174 -sTCP:LISTEN
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:5174/
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:5174/

title: Harness failure: AppleScript keystroke blocked (assistive access)
summary: Could not inject keystrokes into frontmost Electron/Avocado window. osascript System Events error -25211: not allowed assistive access. cliclick not installed.
repro_steps: osascript to set Electron frontmost and keystroke text
Observe -25211 assistive access denial

title: Harness failure: screencapture of Electron window denied
summary: screencapture -R from window-state.json and full-display capture both failed ("could not create image"). Cannot visually confirm Electron gate (onboarding vs chat) without Screen Recording permission.
repro_steps: Read ~/Library/Application Support/Avocado Work/window-state.json bounds
screencapture -x -R x,y,w,h stress/artifacts/electron-window.png
Observe failure without Screen Recording entitlement

title: Playwright browser revision mismatch (mitigated via Chrome channel)
summary: Initial chromium.launch failed: missing ms-playwright chromium_headless_shell-1208. Probe updated to channel:'chrome' (system Google Chrome) and succeeded. Not a product bug.
